description: This file defines the ReplicaKillSwitch class, which implements an event subscriber to manage replica database server access in Drupal, including methods to trigger and check the status of replica servers based on session and request data.

classes.name: ReplicaKillSwitch
classes.description: Implements an event subscriber to control access to replica database servers, allowing temporary disabling based on session flags and request context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings, time, and session dependencies.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Denies access to the replica database if multiple replica servers are detected, setting a session flag to ignore the replica for a specified duration.

methods.name: checkReplicaServer
methods.description: Checks session flags to determine if the replica server should be ignored for the current request, disabling it if necessary.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to, specifically the kernel request event to trigger replica server checks.
